1308|23d8b931.name: Owen Vaughn
1308|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

15008|e2727850.name: Lady Hoteshem
15008|e2727850.text: I've been expecting you $N.  Are you ready to assist us in Arathi Basin?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

252448|1e1e1370.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|1e1e1370.text:
Hmm, what an odd question? Not much, I suppose. My mother used to use it as a powder for babies to prevent diaper rash, but past that, I don't know of any other good use for it.

Why do you ask?

252475|53576371.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|53576371.text:
I see. This seems dangerous in the extreme, but the situation seems to demand that risks be taken.

Very well, the High Order will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

252475|58724dc1.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|58724dc1.text:
The Windshapers are almost wholly to blame for everything that has happened. Their refusal to change has damaged our ability to save ourselves from our current peril. They speak in absolutes and treat assumptions and superstitious hope as fact.

Do you know who else deals only absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valnaar and wipe the Windshapers out.

252479|fb513610.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

253004|a3b7de8e.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|a3b7de8e.text: Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

253004|d62b45b0.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

253474|ba9ef707.name: Peacekeeper
253474|ba9ef707.text: You'll find Lotheluum Starbreeze on a cliff overlooking the waterfall on the eastern edge of town.

256306|909a42e8.name: Arcanist Laurain
256306|909a42e8.text:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek the assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

263930|9d79190e.name: Peacekeeper
263930|9d79190e.text: The Inn can be found on the east side of the road leading northward out of town.

270459|35e7520b.name: Alfina Nightgaze
270459|35e7520b.text:
I was invited to visit Dalaran on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. I find this place equal parts wondrous... and unsettling.

As for you, young $C--If you have not yet done so, seek out Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind. He will teach you to reach the Cenarion Circle enclave at Moonglade.

275269|8059976c.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|8059976c.text: The skycutter that arrives here will take you right to Dalaran City.

275269|d9943d35.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|d9943d35.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

4262|0b538a46.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|0b538a46.text: It is Vesprystus that you seek.  He watches over the hippogryphs that come and go from the base of Teldrassil.  You will find him through the portal in western Darnassus that will take you to Rut'theran Village.

4262|d7aed8f7.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|d7aed8f7.text: Vesprystus' hippogryphs will bear you swiftly to your destination.  Seek him out in Rut'theran Village, through the portal which lies in the western section of Darnassus.

5504|8fca8484.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5504|a2527c6f.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

7410|d72ca075.name: Thelman Slatefist
7410|d72ca075.text: I hope that you are here to go to Alterac Valley $N.  We can use all o' the help that we can get.

7999|ccf70497.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|ccf70497.text:
It pleases me greatly to at last meet one of your people. I've heard much of the shen'dorei and your long history, and I am glad to see our cousins return home to Kalimdor at long last.

I confess that our people have a... complicated relationship with the highborne. Some amongst the night elves are quick to distrust those of highborne descent such as those in your High Order. However, you have my assurance that you will be shown the utmost respect while a guest in our city.

Please, make yourself at home here. I'd encourage you to explore and familiarize yourself with our culture. It is, after all, your culture as well in a way.

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

92640-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92640-accept.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640-accept.title: Desperate Times

92640-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92640-complete.text: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.
92640-complete.title: Desperate Times

92642-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-accept.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642-accept.title: Disrupting Logistics

92642-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.
92642-complete.title: Disrupting Logistics

92643-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92643-accept.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, its worth some risk.
92643-accept.title: The Turncoat

92643-complete.name: Dead Cultist
92643-complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>
92643-complete.title: The Turncoat

92644-accept.name: Dead Cultist
92644-accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644-accept.title: Unfortunate News

92644-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92644-complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...
92644-complete.title: Unfortunate News

92645-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645-accept.title: Breaking the Breaker

92645-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.
92645-complete.title: Breaking the Breaker

92682-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682-progress.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
92683-complete.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683-progress.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
92684-complete.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684-progress.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685-accept.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
92685-complete.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685-progress.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693-accept.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
92693-complete.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

92699-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92699-accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699-accept.title: The Supreme Magister

92699-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92699-complete.text:
Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid The High Order?

I suppose we will see.
92699-complete.title: The Supreme Magister

92701-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92701-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92701-accept.title: To Valanaar

92701-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers I have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
92701-complete.title: To Valanaar

92701-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92701-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92701-progress.title: To Valanaar

92703-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92703-accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $N. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703-accept.title: Deliver the News

92703-complete.name: Alvarion Windfield
92703-complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
92703-complete.title: Deliver the News

92709-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-accept.text: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and its youth like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
92709-accept.title: A Grand Adventure

92709-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-complete.text:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.

Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.

While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.
92709-complete.title: A Grand Adventure

92727-accept.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-accept.text:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92727-complete.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-complete.text: <The satchel lying before you has a few specks of what appears to be dried blood on the flap. Studying the stain you also notice that the flap also has a name embroidered onto it. It reads "Fillion Flamebreeze".>
92727-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92741-accept.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-accept.text:
The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain.

Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
92741-accept.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92741-complete.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-complete.text:
That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!

Thank you for your service to the High Order, $c.
92741-complete.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92834-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-accept.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

Its clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834-accept.title: Avenged Tenfold

92834-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-complete.text:
The High Order prides ourselves in our pragmatism and logic, and logic dictates that the avoidance of conflict and loss of life is the most prudent option in most situations.

<Elaadrin's eyes begin to glow and crackle with arcane energy.>

...however, the cult mistook our prudence for weakness and they are not nearly ready to pay the cost of that error.
92834-complete.title: Avenged Tenfold

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-accept.text:
Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there.

Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now.

Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
92840-accept.title: Catching Wind

92840-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-complete.text:
It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.

Unfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.

$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.
92840-complete.title: Catching Wind

92840-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-progress.text:
It's often difficult for me to establish a distinction between the Windshapers and the Al'Aketh, save that one is more overtly violent than the other. Equally slavish to their misplaced beliefs, they are both equally dangerous if left to their own devices.

They see our desire to better understand this realm and its magic as a desecration of their traditions. Their small-mindedness is why our mission is so important. If not us, who will have the courage to save Zephras?
92840-progress.title: Catching Wind

92849-accept.name: Unknown
92849-accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92849-complete.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92849-complete.text:
Th... thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.

I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.
92849-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92850-accept.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-accept.text:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety however is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

92860-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92860-accept.text:
The High Order has done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there's rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

92860-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92860-complete.text:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92860-complete.title: In Service of Zephras

92880-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92880-accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880-accept.title: Return to Valanaar

92880-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92880-complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.
92880-complete.title: Return to Valanaar

92881-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92881-accept.text:
The attack on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881-accept.title: The High Elder's Request

92881-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92881-complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
92881-complete.title: The High Elder's Request

92947-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92947-accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the Windshapers and High Order in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947-accept.title: Making Our Move

92947-complete.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
92947-complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
92947-complete.title: Making Our Move

93065-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065-accept.title: Prepare for Battle

93065-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.
93065-complete.title: Prepare for Battle

93089-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93089-accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, his mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $N.
93089-accept.title: What Comes Next

93089-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
93089-complete.text:
It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for our vanguard to depart.
93089-complete.title: What Comes Next

93159-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93159-accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159-accept.title: The Strange Hermit

93159-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93159-complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
93159-complete.title: The Strange Hermit

93160-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93160-accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160-accept.title: The Forest's Bounty

93160-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93160-complete.text:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
93160-complete.title: The Forest's Bounty

93160-progress.name: Strange Hermit
93160-progress.text: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
93160-progress.title: The Forest's Bounty

93165-accept.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165-accept.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.
93165-complete.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-progress.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
93165-progress.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93172-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93172-accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172-accept.title: Free the Hollows

93317-complete.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-complete.text:
Winds bless me this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, $c.
93317-complete.title: Crab Season

93317-progress.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
93317-progress.title: Crab Season

93320-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93320-accept.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320-accept.title: Tower Defense

93320-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
93320-complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.
93320-complete.title: Tower Defense

93835-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93835-accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
93835-accept.title: Confront Lorthuna

93835-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
93835-complete.text:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.
93835-complete.title: Confront Lorthuna

93949-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
93949-complete.title: Bugged

93958-accept.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
93958-accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958-accept.title: The Inner Sanctum

93963-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
93963-accept.text:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963-accept.title: Exploring the Alliance

94006-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94006-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006-accept.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94369-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
94369-accept.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369-accept.title: The Fate of Zephras

94369-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94369-complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
94369-complete.title: The Fate of Zephras

94413-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
94413-complete.text:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.
94413-complete.title: A Magical Affront

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-accept.text:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485-accept.title: Tears of the Lady

94485-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
94485-complete.title: Tears of the Lady

94485-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-progress.text: Have you found the Lady's Tear?
94485-progress.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-accept.text:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486-accept.title: Feathers for Binding

94486-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-complete.text: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
94486-complete.title: Feathers for Binding

94486-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
94486-progress.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94487-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-complete.text:
<Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.>

So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, $c.

I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
94487-complete.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94487-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of $c blood they have spilled this day.
94487-progress.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94488-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-accept.text:
The reason for cultists presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488-accept.title: The Ties That Bind

94488-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-complete.text:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
94488-complete.title: The Ties That Bind

94488-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-progress.text: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
94488-progress.title: The Ties That Bind

94489-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489-accept.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94489-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489-complete.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94490-accept.name: Unknown
94490-accept.text: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information for about the cultist motivations for the attack on the $c den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490-accept.title: Ripped Missive

94490-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94490-complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
94490-complete.title: Ripped Missive

94491-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94491-accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491-accept.title: The Fate of the Den

94491-complete.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94491-complete.text:
<Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the $c den.>

I--I'm sorry, $N. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.
94491-complete.title: The Fate of the Den

94568-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of the what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568-accept.title: The Cult's True Plans

94568-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.
94568-complete.title: The Cult's True Plans

94896-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896-complete.title: Aid For The Refugees

94896-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896-progress.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897-complete.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94897-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-progress.text: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, $c, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.
94897-progress.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94912-accept.name: Alfina Nightgaze
94912-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912-accept.title: Child of Nature

94912-complete.name: Sheldras Moontree
94912-complete.text:
Greetings, fellow $c. It pleases me to meet a fellow $c from among the $R, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
94912-complete.title: Child of Nature

94914-accept.name: Sheldras Moontree
94914-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young $c.
94914-accept.title: Moonglade

94946-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
94946-accept.text:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946-accept.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94946-complete.name: Denaaris Stargale
94946-complete.text:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.  

As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.
94946-complete.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94947-accept.name: Denaaris Stargale
94947-accept.text:
Its a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947-accept.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to recieve members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $R.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

97968-complete.name: Syriel Nightrain
97968-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97968-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98021-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98021-accept.text:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!
98021-accept.title: Journey to Sentinel Hill

98512-complete.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512-complete.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

99191-progress.name: Belanaa Windveil
99191-progress.text:
The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99191-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

99260-accept.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
99260-accept.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260-accept.title: Fillion's Mission

99260-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
99260-complete.text:
Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.

As ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
99260-complete.title: Fillion's Mission
